Each quote represents an independent observation of a shared system state. The derivation proceeds by constructing a joint probability space over players and roles, conditioned on editorial weights. Dualities emerge between role assignment and consensus formation: one is deterministic, the other stochastic. Failure modes include missing players, inconsistent roles, or zero-weighted editors. The system exhibits robustness under small perturbations but collapses when key sources become unreliable or contradictory.
